2610.11583.title: SDPAD: A Fully Spike-Driven Pipeline for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
2610.11583.paper_summary: End-to-end autonomous driving demands trajectory planners that are both highly accurate and cheap enough for edge deployment. State-of-the-art artificial neural network (ANN) planners meet the accuracy requirement at the cost of heavy dense computation, while spiking neural networks (SNNs)---though promising orders-of-magnitude energy savings through sparse, event-driven arithmetic---still lag far behind in planning accuracy. We present \textbf{SDPAD}, a fully spike-driven end-to-end planning pipeline that closes this gap. SDPAD converts a pre-trained ANN perception stack into integer-spike form via quantized ANN2SNN conversion, lifts multi-view images into the bird's-eye-view (BEV) space with a spike-driven-max (SDM) depth distribution (Spike-3D-Lift), and plans through the Spike-QFormer, a spiking query transformer in which ego, agent, and map queries distilled from the BEV scene are fused by learnable waypoint queries via cross-attention, followed by deformable spike-cross-attention refinement. Every operation is gated by integer spikes and inference is a single feed-forward pass without temporal simulation loops. On the nuScenes open-loop benchmark, SDPAD achieves an average $L_2$ error of 0.40\,m and a collision rate of 0.12\%, on par with strong ANN planners while consuming 69.9\,mJ---less than 2\% of recent ANN baselines. In closed-loop evaluation on the NAVSIM navtest split, SDPAD reaches 86.3 PDMS, surpassing the previous SNN planner SAD by 4.3 points and matching mainstream ANN planners at a fraction of their energy. To our knowledge, SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven planner evaluated in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating that SNNs can rival dense ANNs in complex driving tasks.
2610.11583.paper_summary_zh: 端到端的自主駕駛需要既高度準確又足夠便宜以便邊緣部署的軌跡規劃器。最先進的人工神經網絡（ANN）規劃器滿足了準確性要求，但代價是需要大量的密集計算，而尖峰神經網絡（SNN）雖然在稀疏、事件驅動的算術中承諾能節省數量級的能量，但在規劃準確性上仍然遠遠落後。我們提出了\textbf{SDPAD}，一個完全由尖峰驅動的端到端規劃管道，填補了這一空白。SDPAD通過量化的ANN2SNN轉換將預訓練的ANN感知堆疊轉換為整數尖峰形式，利用尖峰驅動的最大（SDM）深度分佈將多視角圖像提升到鳥瞰圖（BEV）空間（Spike-3D-Lift），並通過Spike-QFormer進行規劃，這是一種尖峰查詢Transformer，其中從BEV場景中提取的自我、代理和地圖查詢通過可學習的路徑點查詢通過交叉注意力進行融合，隨後進行可變形尖峰交叉注意力的細化。每個操作都由整數尖峰進行閘控，推理是一個單一的前饋傳遞，沒有時間模擬循環。在nuScenes開放循環基準上，SDPAD實現了平均$L_2$誤差為0.40\,m，碰撞率為0.12\%，與強大的ANN規劃器不相上下，同時消耗69.9\,mJ——不到最近ANN基準的2\%。在NAVSIM navtest拆分的閉環評估中，SDPAD達到了86.3 PDMS，超過了之前的SNN規劃器SAD 4.3分，並以其一小部分的能量匹配主流的ANN規劃器。據我們所知，SDPAD是第一個在端到端自主駕駛中評估的完全尖峰驅動的規劃器，證明了SNN在複雜駕駛任務中可以與密集的ANN相抗衡。
